caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a handle on the left side. The pitcher is primarily an off-white or light gray color, with a brownish interior visible at the top. The exterior of the pitcher features a decorative design in a bright cobalt blue, consisting of stylized, curving lines and leaf-like patterns on the right side. There is also blue text partly visible near the upper portion of the pitcher, reading "N. CL" and "ROC," with additional letters partially obscured. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, allowing the pitcher to stand out as the central object in the composition.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
